When a memory is uploaded directly to a person's memory page the person tag is not complete. If you then want to delete the tag you must first "improve" the tag. This requires extra clicks before you can delete the tag. It would be nice to have a "delete tag" option on the edit tag (gear icon) menu which would allow a direct delete of the partial tag.

BTW I just helped a public guest through the process of deleting over 160 partial tags on a single person's page. It took a lot of clicks. (Open memory, click gear, click improve tag, click the green checkmark, click delete, click confirm delete, click the back arrow to go back to the person's memories).

Another option would be to allow us to select multiple memories on a person's memory page and remove the tag from all checked memories.

Having said all of that I can understand why it might be best to keep it a one memory at a time process.

Do what you feel is best.

Elder Kevin Augustus Long, Support Center service missionary.
